title: Agent tray task
description: A task of the agent tray (contract fixed in 0.8.0, tray in 0.11.0): something that needs judgement, who has it and what was answered. The validator of gimg has no conditional keywords: `answer` is checked against the definition that `type` names (`$defs/answerSubject`, `answerJudgment`, `answerRedesign`, `answerChoice`, `answerSheet`; see `tests/test_agent_task.py`). Each answer is exactly the body of an API route that exists today, so a form and `gimg agent answer` share one shape.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

id.description: Task number, unique in the tray.

type.description: subject: write the subject of a brand order (answerSubject). judgment: judge by trait what cannot be measured (answerJudgment). redesign: after 3 failed batches, a troubleshooting row (answerRedesign). choice: choose between candidates (answerChoice). sheet: the first brand sheet (answerSheet).

state.description: pending: waits for an answer. answered: answered, not applied yet. applied: the person applied it. rejected: the person refused it (the reason goes in `rejection`; the task goes back to pending). expired: the order changed since it was asked; the answer cannot be applied.

order.description: The linked order (absent for `sheet`, which belongs to the project).

context.description: What the answerer needs to see: thumbnails (attempt ids), notes, reasons. Free shape, read only.

rejection.description: Why the person rejected the answer.

answerJudgment.description: A verdict per trait of the sheet on one attempt: the attempt's `human` (`{<trait>: ok|bad}`). Each `bad` one is a `reason.trait` of `POST .../attempts/{id}/mark`.

answerChoice.description: `attempt` is the body of `POST .../orders/{profile}/{key}/choose`; `reason` is kept in the task.

answerSheet.description: The first brand sheet: `sheet` is a whole `brand-sheet.schema.json` document (the validator does not follow references between files; the tests validate it against that schema).
